name: ASK AUTOMOTIVE LIMITED
summary: ASK Automotive Limited manufactures and sells auto components for the automobile industry in India. The company offers advanced braking systems, such as brake shoe and pad, brake panel assembly, clutch plate and shoe, brake linings, disc brake pad, and brake liner. It also provides aluminum lightweighting precision solutions for two and four-wheeler and electric vehicles. In addition, the company offers safety control cables, including front and rear brake cable assembly, throttle and speedometer cable assembly, clutch cables assembly, and starter cable/choke cable assembly products, as well as seat lock, fuel lid, and accelerator cables. It serves original equipment manufacturers. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Gurugram, India.
